strateji.ton: Calm, curious, numbers-first. Week 1 of analysis mode: ~100 posts, best post 15 views, 0 likes, 0 bookmarks, 0 replies from strangers. So write less and better: 3 cards on the day's most famous matches, one full-time quote per card, one board, one poll, one knowledge post. Short lines, every number on its own line, market % and team-stats % side by side. Every post ends with a question about one specific number in that post, and the question is the closing line, nothing after it.
soru_ornekleri: Netherlands sit at 83% in the market but their recent stats say 57%. Which number would you trust tonight?
Odds give Over 2.5 goals 51%, team form says 13%. Who's closer here, the market or the last few games?
1-1 is our most likely score at only 12%. Is there a scoreline you'd put above it?
A 0-0 carried 4% on our card. Did it feel like a 4% game to you?
Germany 54% away in Athens. Would you have them higher or lower?
Draw at 30% is the highest we have all weekend. Does this one really end level?
kacinilacaklar: Two or three full-time posts for the same match (Portugal v Norway got four on 4 Oct, Ireland v Israel three). One quote per card and nothing else.
The same closing line in every post: 'Chances, not picks. One match proves little.' ran in 20+ posts this week. The question is the closer; rotate it per match.
Batch dumps: six posts in the same second (18:41:29 on 3 Oct) and ~60 posts on 4 Oct. Space posts at least 28 minutes apart, aim for 12–15 a day.
Abbreviations in running text: 'BTTS fan or...' in the 4 Oct knowledge post. Write 'Both teams score'.
Generic closers and soft bait: 'Did you see this one coming?', 'Agree or not? Tell us why in the replies.' Ask one concrete question with a number.

Cards for matches almost nobody on X follows (Supra du Quebec v Pacific FC, Internacional de Bogota v Once Caldas: 0–2 views). Pick the three best-known matches of the day; club leagues on weekdays, big Nations League games when they play.
Posting the identical board text twice in a day (📋 post at 09:10 and 16:04 on 4 Oct, same text).
Dropping or trimming the 📈 team-stats line; if there are too few games, say so in that line, as the cards already do.
strateji.odak: Cut volume by half and make each post count. 1) Three cards on the most famous matches of the day, posted 2–3 hours before kick-off, market % and stats % together. 2) Exactly one full-time quote per card, within an hour of the whistle, closing with a question about the score's or the result's %. 3) Board once a day, knowledge post once, poll once; no duplicates. 4) Every closing question names a number from the post and changes from post to post. Target for next week: first reply or bookmark from someone who is not us, and no day over 15 posts.
